content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Venezuela, digital creators face significant hurdles with conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-one-afternoon-fast-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms such as Stripe and PayPal. These restrictions prevent you from realizing the revenue potential of your digital products. Fortunately, deploying a digital store using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-what-actually-10|cloudflare]] Pages provides a robust solution. This guide will walk you through setting up a full-fledged digital store for free, utilizing the COREMERCH [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-4|The Full]] that guarantees you complete ownership and control.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment platforms often impose restrictions based on geographical limitations, leaving many creators in financial isolation. COREMERCH's infrastructure circumvents these barriers by allowing creators to utilize cryptocurrency payments. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages as your hosting solution, you gain immediate access to a reliable and scalable platform that aligns perfectly with the needs of the modern digital creator. With features like automatic crypto payment processing and no dependence on third-party platforms, this architecture ensures that your digital assets remain under your control.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, ensure you have a GitHub account and basic familiarity with version control. You will also need a Cloudflare account for page hosting. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will serve as your backend logic. Prepare your digital products, whether they are ebooks, courses, or templates, and gather your cryptocurrency wallets for payment processing. Lastly, have a clear deployment plan that includes your product listings and pricing strategies to streamline the setup process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend using Google Apps Script, configuring it to handle incoming orders and payment verification. Implement NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions, ensuring that your customers can pay with over 300 cryptocurrencies. Once the payment system is in place, set up your file delivery mechanism using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to automatically deliver products upon successful payment confirmation. This step is crucial for maintaining customer satisfaction and trust.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up and tested, it's time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site and ensure that your payment processing system is functional. Perform a test transaction to verify that payments are processed correctly and that customers receive their products as intended. Monitor the transaction flow closely during the initial phase to catch any potential issues early on. Once you confirm everything functions smoothly, promote your store through social media and other channels.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After a successful deployment, consider scaling your operation. You can expand your product offerings beyond the initial five products supported by the Edge Commerce Stack. Utilize Supabase to manage customer data effectively, and implement additional marketing strategies to reach a broader audience. The flexibility of this infrastructure allows you to adapt to market demands while maintaining full ownership of your assets.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
No subscription fees, lifetime access.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, set up a Cloudflare Pages site, use Google Apps Script for backend functions, and integrate NOWPayments for handling transactions. This configuration allows you to process payments without relying on mainstream payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for a straightforward setup, deploying in 4-6 hours. Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, offering advanced features like end-to-end testing and deployment within 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms provide reliable hosting solutions that support the deployment of your online store while allowing you to manage payments efficiently.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments offers automatic crypto payment processing with over 300 currencies, low fees of 0.5%, and no buyer accounts needed. This makes it an ideal solution for creators looking to monetize digital products without the complexities of traditional payment systems.
How can I ensure my product delivery is seamless?

To ensure seamless product delivery, set up an automated system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This will allow customers to receive their digital products instantly upon successful payment, enhancing their overall experience.
